name: Abdarainurus
sum: Abdarainurus is a titanosaur from the Alagteeg Formation of Mongolia, known from eight front and one middle tail vertebrae and possibly a distinct Asian lineage.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: PIN 5669/1 (as labelled on the Commons skeletal drawing), tail vertebrae.
material: Eight anterior caudal vertebrae and one middle caudal vertebra.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Averianov and Lopatin 2020

images.caption: Skeletal reconstruction of Abdarainurus barsboldi showing the preserved bones.
